title: The janitor sweep frees a dead host's agent worktree on Windows and Mac too, or the measured reason is recorded
why: The sweep keeps a dead host's tree off Linux, so the owner's Windows and Mac keep stale trees; testing only on Linux hides it.
source: Consultant 18:37 CST Nov 13, relaying the owner at 18:31 CST ("we still deem it fine by just testing on linux and avoid testing it on windows? thats a good idea for an outcome?"); unchecked by triage.
note: Filed 18:33 CST Nov 13. Fact (consultant): janitor/sweep.py _ticks_lock_stale returns None off Linux, so a dead host's tree is kept. Wanted: measure on the owner's Windows and Mac which lock form a dead host leaves; build the platform read where the ticks form occurs, with tests on that platform's CI job; else record the measured reason. #3303 is the bandaid that turns main green meanwhile. Relation: sweep-mutants-windows-skip. Past rulings not checked. Needs a session on the owner's computers for the measure. Not started.
